fact: DIAL says Ethiopia is developing its first national data governance strategy, begun under the Office of the Prime Minister with a technical committee from INSA, MiNT, the Ethiopian AI Institute and Addis Ababa University, which produced a draft framework that DIAL helped expand into a full draft strategy reviewed at a workshop.
source_slug: 2025-09-18 Ethiopia's approach to their National Data Strategy offers lessons for Africa's digital future

fact: DIAL's project page says it developed Ethiopia's first national data governance strategy in 2025 with the Office of the Prime Minister and lists a strategy launch and validation workshop among its 2026 plans, so the strategy was not yet launched; the page's own published date is 2024-02-12 but it describes 2025 work.

ENA reports the Council of Ministers evaluated the National Data Governance Draft Proclamation and unanimously referred the bill to the House of Peoples' Representatives; it is a draft law, not yet enacted.
